class Bad:
    n: int

def check(x: int) -> int fail Bad:
    """Return x when it is even, otherwise fail with Bad carrying x."""
    post out == x
    ex check(4) == 4
    ex check(3) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    if x % 2 == 1:
        fail Bad(n=x)
    return x

def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Check every element in parallel and return the checked values in order.

    If any element is odd, fail with the Bad of the lowest-index odd element.
    """
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 4, 6]
    ex all_even([2, 3, 5]) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    ex all_even([]) == []
    out = par [check(x)? for x in xs]
    return out
